concerns.text: FR-004 assumes the relationship between spatial correlation length and PCE is linear or monotonic to justify using Pearson correlation, then uses Pearson correlation to test that same linear/monotonic assumption. This creates a circular validation where the predictor‑validation relationship is not independent.

FR-004 and the associated success criteria rely solely on p‑values for significance testing without reporting confidence intervals or effect sizes for the correlation coefficients. Given the expected small sample size (≈30 or fewer), p‑values alone are insufficient to support scientific conclusions.

FR-001 aborts all statistical modeling if fewer than 10 EDS samples are available, which can prevent any inferential analysis and leaves the core research question unanswered in the likely scenario of limited data. The design should allow at least exploratory analysis or estimation reporting rather than a hard abort.
